title: A paired venture screening study recorded lower analyst time for AI-assisted reports
summary: In a paired study of 20 applications at one investment firm, mean analyst time was 44.7 minutes for manual screening and 18.9 minutes for screening with GPT-6 Luna-assisted reports. Assisted time included verifying sources and making corrections. Seventy percent of reports needed at least one correction.
ai_technology: GPT-6 Luna; document interpretation and evidence-assisted scoring
organization: Queen’s University Belfast; Sapphire Capital Partners

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 timing and factual-support protocol and results, Appendix A model configuration, funding and ethics notes

evidence.tested: Each application was independently processed by both workflows, with a different analyst in each and roles counterbalanced. The analysts also adjudicated the factual support of 240 cited claims.
evidence.unknown: Two analysts affiliated with the participating fund completed the unblinded comparison. Each application was assessed by a different analyst in each workflow, so counterbalancing leaves analyst-by-workflow effects unresolved. The assisted time excludes unattended machine time. Decision quality and returns were outside this comparison.
evidence.ai_role: DealsFlow used GPT-6 Luna to extract and score supporting information from application documents and retrieved sources. Analysts then verified and corrected the resulting reports.
